Package org.geysermc.paletter.item

Class ItemRegistry.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.item.ItemRegistry.Builder
Enclosing class:
ItemRegistry
@Internal public static final class ItemRegistry.Builder extends Object
Builds an item palette. Obtained from ItemRegistry.vanilla(org.geysermc.paletter.internal.data.VanillaData, org.geysermc.paletter.block.BlockRegistry, org.geysermc.paletter.internal.CanonicalItems) or ItemRegistry.extend(org.geysermc.paletter.block.BlockRegistry, org.geysermc.paletter.internal.CanonicalItems); used by the palette compiler.
